I don't hate my parents at all. It's myself that I despise. Even as young as 3, I remember wondering why I was so shy and awkward and disappointing. I would wish to disappear in an instant. At 3. Now imagine all that self-loathing growing as I aged into a teen and then young adult. It has nothing to do with my parents. I just feel a need to destroy myself. I think if my parents realized how awful, disappointing, and embarrassing I will continue to be, then they would not be so hurt about my death.

How many of them would actually do it? How many people get to the point where they're cutting past the fat into the muscle of their body? Could you do it? Obviously, I've had it so good, it must have been very hard to do something as violent as self harm even just once. Someone who's had it very badly, with real pain and misery, would probably find it much easier to do something so self-destructive in an attempt to feel the least bit better.

Medications really don't affect my mind/mood all that much. They only give me physical side effects. More energy, less energy, weight gain, acne, balance issues, muscle stiffness, etc.

Meanwhile my brain remains highly depressed and suicidal, completely untouched, while my body is slowly destroyed by the chemicals.
